subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.zh: 查报案号码，确认他的身份。
subtitles.en: Check the caller's number and identity.

subtitles.speaker: 警员（无线电）
subtitles.zh: 登记人叫赵成，是这里的门卫。
subtitles.en: It's registered to Zhao Cheng, the building's guard.

subtitles.speaker: 许未
subtitles.zh: 检刺，两只手腕都有环形擦伤。
subtitles.en: Jian Ci, there are ring-shaped abrasions on both wrists.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.zh: 有可能，还要排除衣物和搬运造成的痕迹。
subtitles.en: Possibly. We must also rule out marks from clothing or handling.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.zh: 林浅，查一下顾晴昨晚的去向。
subtitles.en: Lin Qian, trace Gu Qing's movements last night.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅（电话）
subtitles.zh: 我在门卫室。赵成没来交班。
subtitles.en: I'm at the guardroom. Zhao Cheng missed the handover.

subtitles.speaker: 警员
subtitles.zh: 赵成昨晚值班，备用钥匙在我这。
subtitles.en: Zhao Cheng worked last night. I have the spare key.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.zh: 开门。先别碰里面的东西。
subtitles.en: Open it. Don't touch anything inside yet.

subtitles.speaker: 警员
subtitles.en: Detective Lin, Zhao Cheng's phone is ringing.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: Don't answer yet. Photograph the screen.
